name: Wet Cloth
description: Jim's good galley cloth, soaked and wrung. Tied over your nose and mouth. Jim doesn't want it back.

name: Bottle Goggles
description: Two thick green bottle-bottoms in a leather strap, from the hold's salvage crate. The world, through them, is green.

name: Waist Rope
description: Good line, tied round your middle by Gristle, with a knot you've never seen him use. So they can pull you out.

name: Beard Wrap
description: Your clean black neckerchief, wrapped round your whole beard. Your beard has been waiting a month to get at you.

name: Bob's Pot
description: A clay pot. On your head. In case. It smells faintly of soup.

name: The Sash
description: The Grand Stenchmaster's ceremonial sash, verified authentic (by inhalation). In your custody for the Silence. History should not smell like that.
